==================
types: generics and bounds
==================

fn pick[T: Eq + Ord + Show](a: T, b: T) -> T {
    if a == b { a } else { b }
}

impl[T: Show] Stack[T] {
    fn show(self) -> str { "{self.items}" }
}

==================
types: optional binds to the base type
==================

fn reads(value: fn() -> int?) -> Option[fn() -> int] {
    Some(fn() => 1)
}
